page.overview:
What is Moa Moa no Mi?

The Moa Moa no Mi is a Paramecia-class Devil Fruit that allows the user to amplify the size or speed of any object they touch. It was eaten by Byrnndi World.

The main strength of this fruit is that it allows the user to increase either the speed or size of the things the user touches, up to 100 times the original. This can be used on ammunition like bullets and cannonballs, as well as the user's own speed. The increased speed can bring forth powerful momentum to increase the power of the user's physical attacks, while the sudden increase in size can increase physical strength and destructive range of the weapon.

The user has yet to be seen increasing both the size and speed of a target, meaning that they must choose either one to increase. Other than that, it has no known weaknesses aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Byrnndi World primarily uses this fruit's power in combat, using it to increase the size of weapons and projectiles such as a scythe and bullets. This grants him tremendous physical attack force at unexpected timing, while moving at very difficult to perceive speed and turning simple makeshift ammunition into high-speed projectiles.
